_comment: Settings of tools/agent-workflow/ci_window.py (T-022, docs/ci.md). Every key is required; unknown keys are refused. The remote, branch, forbidden path prefixes and suffixes and the git timeout are read from guard_config.json (git_guard.push_remote, git_guard.push_branch, push_guard.forbidden_*, git_timeout_seconds), never repeated here. run_timeout_seconds = 4200 was refit after run 43820753462 (PM value pending user review): one job per suite, the Windows tooling suite estimated at about 37 min, the job limit 60 min (ci.yml), plus queueing margin. secret_scanner holds one entry per sys.platform value, because the binary is per platform: gitleaks 8.30.1, approved by the user with its download into the project (decision 113), installed by the PM for Windows x64 and checked against the release checksums; its executable path is relative to the project root, its SHA-256 is checked before and after every scan, and version must equal what the binary prints for version_args (gitleaks: `version`). run_ledger records the run ids this tool dispatched; a retained run or artifact not in it refuses the window (T-022 fix round 2, PM decision pending user review). ledger_lock_timeout_seconds (1-120) bounds the wait for another window's locked ledger read or write; past it the read refuses before publication and the write is a window error (T-022 fix round 3). linux stays pin_required, so a window opened on Linux refuses until that binary is placed and pinned.
